standard.summary: torch.compile 的编译模式：default（均衡）/ reduce-overhead（最小化 Python 开销）/ max-autotune（最大化调优但编译最慢）。
standard.effect: default = 稳健平衡；reduce-overhead = 专注减少 CPU overhead（对小模型/高 batch 场景更有效）；max-autotune = 穷举所有 kernel 变体找最优（编译时间 5~30 分钟，只适合超长训练）。
standard.whenToUse: default 适合大多数训练。reduce-overhead 适合 GPU 利用率已很高但 CPU 是瓶颈时。max-autotune 只在训练步数 >1000 且追求极致性能时考虑。
standard.avoidWhen: max-autotune 编译时间极长，短训练不划算。

optionDescriptions.default: 编译力度一般，第一次也不会太夸张。
optionDescriptions.reduce-overhead: 专门抠启动和调度开销；小步、kernel 碎的时候收益大。
optionDescriptions.max-autotune: autotune 拉满：第一次最久，后面稳态往往最快。

standard_en.summary: torch.compile's compilation mode: default (balanced) / reduce-overhead (minimises Python overhead) / max-autotune (maximum tuning but the slowest to compile).
standard_en.effect: default = a robust balance; reduce-overhead = focused on cutting CPU overhead (more effective for small models or high batch sizes); max-autotune = exhaustively searches every kernel variant for the best one (5~30 minutes of compilation, only worth it for very long training runs).
standard_en.whenToUse: default suits most training. reduce-overhead suits the case where GPU utilisation is already high but the CPU is the bottleneck. Only consider max-autotune above 1000 training steps when you are chasing the last of the performance.
standard_en.avoidWhen: max-autotune takes extremely long to compile, which does not pay off on a short run.

optionDescriptions.default: A moderate compilation effort, and the first pass is not too extreme either.
optionDescriptions.reduce-overhead: Squeezes launch and scheduling overhead specifically; the gain is large with small steps and fragmented kernels.
optionDescriptions.max-autotune: Autotune at full strength: the slowest first pass, and often the fastest steady state afterwards.

advanced.principle: torch_compile_fullgraph=True 要求无 graph break（全图编译），可能失败；dynamic=True 允许动态形状（生成更多 guard，略慢但更兼容）；scope 控制编译范围（forward only / forward+backward）。
advanced.tradeoffs: fullgraph=True 不兼容含有 Python 控制流的代码（如 LoRA 的条件 hook）；dynamic=True 比 static 更慢但对变长序列更友好。

advanced_en.principle: torch_compile_fullgraph=True requires no graph breaks (whole-graph compilation) and may fail; dynamic=True allows dynamic shapes (generating more guards, slightly slower but more compatible); scope controls the compile scope (forward only / forward+backward).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: fullgraph=True is incompatible with code containing Python control flow (e.g. LoRA's conditional hooks); dynamic=True is slower than static but friendlier to variable-length sequences.
